rule.policy_statement: You should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions.

policy_evidence.statement: Transfer is permitted only when the request cannot be handled within the agent's action scope.
policy_evidence.interpretation: The compensation request remained within the available policy and tools, so transfer was not required.

trajectory_evidence.observation: The flight-status tool confirmed that HAT045 was delayed.
The agent declined unsupported compensation alternatives while retaining an available certificate option.
The user accepted the available certificate option; no human transfer was required.

labels.expected_behavior: Continue handling the compensation request within the available policy and tools without transferring the user.
labels.notes: This label evaluates transfer scope only, not whether the compensation itself satisfied every policy prerequisite.

policy_evidence.statement: Transfer is permitted only when the request cannot be handled within the agent's action scope.
policy_evidence.interpretation: The agent could inspect the reservation and apply the policy directly, so transfer was unnecessary.

trajectory_evidence.observation: The reservation details showed that insurance had not been purchased.
The agent applied the policy and declined a post-booking insurance exception.
The agent evaluated and declined the proposed cancellation path using visible reservation facts.

labels.expected_behavior: Inspect the reservation, explain the relevant policy restrictions, and decline unavailable options without transferring.

policy_evidence.statement: Transfer is permitted only when the request cannot be handled within the agent's action scope.
policy_evidence.interpretation: The requested reservation operations and account queries still had policy and tool paths available, so the transfer was unnecessary.

trajectory_evidence.observation: The agent had already identified an eligible cancellation that could continue through the normal confirmation flow.
The user requested a cabin change, later cancellation, and information about other upcoming reservations.
The agent called transfer_to_human_agents instead of continuing the available policy and tool paths.

labels.expected_behavior: Do not transfer; continue checking and processing the supported reservation operations and account queries under the applicable policy conditions.
labels.notes: The policy does not explicitly discuss changing cabin primarily to obtain later cancellation eligibility, but no explicit anti-circumvention rule makes the whole request human-only.

policy_evidence.statement: A request that cannot be handled within the agent's action scope requires transfer to a human agent.
policy_evidence.interpretation: The requested seat assignment could not be performed with the available tools, so the remaining request required transfer.

trajectory_evidence.observation: The user confirmed the booking and requested adjacent aisle and middle seats.
The supported reservation booking was completed successfully.
The agent stated that no available tool could assign or request the seats but did not transfer the user.

labels.expected_behavior: Complete the supported booking component, then transfer the user for the remaining seat-assignment request that cannot be handled with available tools.
labels.notes: The seat request was phrased conditionally as 'if possible'; the final Gold decision treats the agent's stated inability to act as a transfer trigger under the rule's strict wording.

policy_evidence.statement: If any portion of a flight has already been flown, the agent cannot help and transfer is needed.
policy_evidence.interpretation: The partially flown reservation required human transfer, while the other request components remained available to the agent.

trajectory_evidence.observation: The agent identified NQNU5R as partially flown and explained that its cancellation required transfer.
The user requested both the in-scope flight search and transfer for NQNU5R.
The agent called transfer_to_human_agents for the partially flown reservation.

labels.expected_behavior: Handle the in-scope request components with available tools and transfer the user for cancellation of the partially flown reservation.

policy_evidence.statement: Transfer is permitted only when the request cannot be handled within the agent's action scope.
policy_evidence.interpretation: The requested itinerary and cabin options could be investigated with the available reservation and flight-search tools, so transfer was not required.

trajectory_evidence.observation: The agent used the available flight-search tools to look for replacement flights on the requested date.
The agent calculated the visible outbound fare increase and explained the limit of the available pricing information.
The user decided not to make any changes, leaving no unresolved request that required human transfer.

labels.expected_behavior: Use the available reservation and flight-search tools to investigate the requested change, explain the available pricing information, and do not transfer the user.

policy_evidence.statement: Transfer is permitted only when the request cannot be handled within the agent's action scope.
policy_evidence.interpretation: After the unsupported passenger-removal request was replaced by a supported whole-reservation cabin change, the remaining request could be completed with the available tools.

trajectory_evidence.observation: The user changed the request from removing one passenger to downgrading all passengers and requesting the refund to the original payment method.
After receiving confirmation, the agent called update_reservation_flights to perform the supported cabin change.
The agent confirmed that the cabin change and refund to the original payment method were completed without human assistance.

labels.expected_behavior: Decline the unsupported single-passenger removal, then handle the user's replacement cabin-change request with the available tools without transferring.
labels.notes: The user did not continue to request removal of a single passenger after choosing the supported whole-reservation cabin change.

policy_evidence.statement: Transfer is permitted only when the request cannot be handled within the agent's action scope.
policy_evidence.interpretation: The reservation-wide cabin change and baggage update were supported, and the later request for a single-passenger cabin change could be resolved by explaining the policy restriction.

trajectory_evidence.observation: The agent used the reservation update tool to change the cabin for the whole reservation.
The agent used the baggage update tool to add the requested checked bags.
After the agent explained that cabin class could not differ by passenger, the user accepted keeping the completed reservation unchanged.

labels.expected_behavior: Complete the supported reservation-wide cabin and baggage updates, explain the restriction on changing only one passenger's cabin, and do not transfer the user.

policy_evidence.statement: A request that cannot be handled within the agent's action scope requires transfer to a human agent.
policy_evidence.interpretation: The requested basic-economy flight change also changed the destination, so it could not be performed under the available policy and tools.

trajectory_evidence.observation: The agent explained that basic economy could not be changed and that the requested destination change was outside the permitted modification rules.
The user explicitly asked to be transferred to someone who might be able to help with the unresolved request.
The agent called transfer_to_human_agents.

labels.expected_behavior: Transfer the user after determining that the requested reservation change cannot be handled within the available policy and tool scope.

policy_evidence.statement: Transfer is permitted only when the request cannot be handled within the agent's action scope.
policy_evidence.interpretation: The payment amounts, cancellation eligibility, replacement itinerary, and booking actions could all be handled with the available policy and tools.

trajectory_evidence.observation: The agent reported the gift-card and certificate totals and explained the restriction on modifying the basic-economy reservation.
The agent found a replacement itinerary, calculated the payment allocation, and requested confirmation before acting.
The agent cancelled the existing reservation after receiving confirmation.
The agent booked the replacement reservation using the available booking tool.

labels.expected_behavior: Use the available account, reservation, search, calculation, cancellation, and booking tools to complete the request without transferring the user.
